notes: GiVo Server 1.0 (build 62) for macOS, Windows and Linux/Docker. Guide scheduling fixes from the release review: the refresh card's next-refresh time now matches the pass that will actually run; a channel lane that stopped answering no longer refetches the whole guide every hour for six hours; a guide slice whose stored guide cannot be loaded runs a full pass instead of publishing a partial one; a portal that rejects its session is not re-armed every ten minutes; and the ad-scan "No breaks found" state requires a readable scan result. A VOD catalogue crawl that draws a rate limit now stands down for six hours, so it stops pausing that host's guide sweep every hour.
